query:
with upserted as (
                insert into category_scheme as existing (
                    id,
                    ap_id,
                    name,
                    owner_ap_id,
                    top_concepts_ap_id,
                    is_local,
                    last_refreshed_at
                )
                values (
                    $1,
                    $2,
                    $3,
                    $4,
                    $5,
                    $6,
                    now()
                )
                on conflict (ap_id) do update
                set
                    name = excluded.name,
                    owner_ap_id = excluded.ap_id,
                    top_concepts_ap_id = excluded.top_concepts_ap_id,
                    last_refreshed_at = now()
                where existing.is_local = false

                returning *
            ),

            candidate as (
                select *
                from upserted

                union all

                select *
                from category_scheme
                where ap_id = $2
                  and not exists (
                      select 1
                      from upserted
                  )
            )

            select
                id as "id!",
                ap_id as "ap_id!: _",
                name as "name!",

                owner_ap_id as "owner_ap_id!: _",
                top_concepts_ap_id as "top_concepts_ap_id?: _",

                is_local as "is_local!",

                last_refreshed_at as "last_refreshed_at?",

                created_at as "created_at!",
                updated_at as "updated_at!"
            from candidate
            limit 1
